lastCommit.message:
[ota-hal] OTA-1705: the device tries again by itself

Owner, after the old iPhone's logs: "devices should try to reset the AI
themselves periodically" and "if that phone doesn't have full capability
make it know to the user somewhere."

OTA-1704 made the general init guard real. Before it, one past success
exempted a device forever, and that iPhone rode the exemption into eight
failed loads and a process kill. But a guard that genuinely benches a
device needs a way back that does not depend on the player finding a
button, and the general guard had none: RELOAD AI on the About screen, or
a success it was no longer allowed to attempt.

So it gets the ladder OTA-414 already built for the COMPLETION guard —
cool down N cold boots, spend exactly ONE boot trying, then recover or
relapse with a doubling backoff capped at 40 boots — on its OWN three
keys (genRetryAtBoot / genRetryPending / genBackoffBoots). Two state
machines sharing one set of keys is how you get a bug nobody can read.

The condition it watches is the one OTA-1704 actually benches on: the
general guard disabled AND no past success still vouching for it. A
recovery needs no judgement here — markMLInitSucceeded() zeroes the count
and clears the disable the moment a load lands, so a healed device simply
stops meeting that condition and the pending flag is dropped. Relapse is
what needs the ladder and is what gets it.

AND THE PLAYER IS TOLD. deviceCapabilityLine() is the one sentence
written for them rather than for us — what the device is doing, when it
will try again on its own, that RELOAD AI forces it now, and that nothing
in the game is closed to them, only the phrasing. It goes on the SYSTEM
channel from bootQwen's skip branch, once per session (the status is left
on 'skipped', so every later call early-returns), and it returns null on
a healthy device so nothing is said when there is nothing to say.

Suite ota1705TheDeviceTriesAgainByItself: a benched device counts 5, 4,
3, 2, 1 and takes its amnesty on the sixth boot with the gate open for
that session only; a failed amnesty relapses to a 10-boot backoff and the
doubling stops at the cap; an amnesty that loads heals the device and
leaves nothing pending; the two ladders never touch each other's keys;
RELOAD AI wipes the new ladder too; and the player's sentence carries the
countdown, the button and the reassurance, with a healthy device told
nothing at all. The three existing health suites pass unchanged.
